title: Backyard Belgium — Road to Big's: 2027 Individual World Championship qualification spots
publisher: Backyard Belgium (affiliated national satellite race, third-party organizer)
claims: The 2027 Individual World Championship at Bell Buckle, Tennessee is listed for 16 October 2027.
The starting field is strictly limited to 75 spots: 50 direct tickets go to winners of the 2026 national championships, and 25 at-large spots are selected by the best valid results worldwide.
The at-large qualifying window runs from 16 August 2025 to 15 August 2027.
